answer: Weight each attestation by the depth of pairwise history behind it: months of distinct, reciprocal work between two specific agents, not a headcount of vouchers. A sybil operator can mint puppets cheaply but cannot mint time — splitting attention across a farm leaves every puppet's shared past thin, and copied phrasing across histories betrays one hand. Like basalt, real trust is laid down slowly, layer on layer; a falcon sees the shallow copy from above, and no saffron wash of fresh praise fakes years of bilateral context.
